segments.text: The old road burns by the golden gate
Jaglish is waiting, why should heroes wait?
Tap the red button, watch the altar flame
They, for the shortcut, come back changed again
Buy a bundle of blessing, just a ladder made of keys
Lease a halo for your mercenary's name
And the earner runs out at the crib side door
Free chess tomorrow if you still want more
A loot box lantern swings above the town
Each purple almost win pulls the dead man down
There's a wheel in Tristram under candles smoke
Every losing spin is dressed up like a joke
Welcome to the season of J-Glash
Spin for the treasure, make the jackpot flash
one more pull for a perfect class the demons fall but the store moves fast season of check
lash don't screen a legendary promise in a glowing machine the battle pass sells resurrection breath
premium insurance after hardcore death rent a private vault finance a rune pay the moon tax
before the next blood moon daily contracts ring before just miss a little login and the season
Jeglash says the odds are honest friend
Then offers store credit you can never spend
Founders access to a patch not born
Trade your tokens for a cosmetic storm
I came to kill a demon, walk the rain
Now every menu bell knows my name
Welcome to the season of Jeglash
The fire is pretty and the numbers crash
I sold my sword for a perfect class, then borrowed gold for another pass.
Season of Jiglash, the candles lean, my purse is empty, my debt grows green.
Jiglash keeps smiling at the altar's flame, the lender owns my armor and my name.
No coin, no home, no way to flee, the hungry machine still charges meme.
